bug.name: Bug Report
bug.description: Report an unexpected problem or behavior.

fields.heading: Steps to reproduce
fields.description: Minimal steps that reproduce the behavior.

fields.heading: Expected behavior
fields.description: What should happen?

fields.heading: Actual behavior
fields.description: What actually happens? Include error messages, stack traces, or screenshots.

fields.heading: Severity
fields.description: How bad is it? Say why under Severity justification.

fields.heading: Severity justification
fields.description: One sentence: the blast radius, what it blocks, or the data at risk.

fields.heading: Suggested fix location
fields.description: The file and function or class where the fix likely belongs, if known. No patch.

fields.heading: Environment
fields.description: OS, runtime and tool versions, and anything else relevant.

feature.name: Feature Request
feature.description: Propose a new feature or enhancement.

fields.heading: User story
fields.description: Who benefits and why?
fields.placeholder: As a [role], I want [capability] so that [benefit].

fields.heading: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: How do we know this is done? One verifiable check per line.

fields.heading: Affected area / component
fields.description: Which part of the project would this affect?

task.name: Task
task.description: A chore, maintenance task, audit, or other housekeeping item.

fields.heading: Context
fields.description: What surfaced this, and what leaving it costs.

fields.heading: Proposed work
fields.description: The concrete next actions.

fields.heading: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: One verifiable check per line.

fields.heading: References
fields.description: Rules, files, pull requests, or docs this relates to.

agent-ready.name: Agent-Ready Work Item
agent-ready.description: Work written as an agent brief. Triage decides its type and whether it is agent-ready.

fields.heading: Summary
fields.description: The change, in one line.

fields.heading: Root cause
fields.description: Bugs only: unknown, or known: the cause in one line.

fields.heading: Current behavior
fields.description: What the code does today.

fields.heading: Desired behavior
fields.description: What is true once this lands, edge cases and failure handling included. The end state, not edit instructions.

fields.heading: Key interfaces
fields.description: The types, signatures, config keys, or observable behaviors that change, named by contract rather than file path or line.

fields.heading: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: Checks that each give a yes or no.

fields.heading: Out of scope
fields.description: The neighboring code and features this change leaves as they are.

decomposed-item.name: Decomposed work item
decomposed-item.description: A vertical slice /work-items:decompose publishes, born triaged; no public form.

fields.heading: Outcome
fields.description: The one observable change a user gets when this slice merges, end to end.

fields.heading: Key interfaces
fields.description: The design this slice touches, named by contract, or None.

fields.heading: Done when
fields.description: The slice's acceptance criteria, each a check with a pass or fail answer.

fields.heading: Out of scope
fields.description: Adjacent work this slice must not change.
